title: Numerical gradient and gradient check
summary: Estimate a gradient with central differences for an input of any shape, and compare it with an analytic gradient by relative error.

mutants.forward_difference: Uses (f(x+h) - f(x)) / h, which has an error of order h and not h squared.
mutants.half_denominator: Divides the central difference by h and not by 2h, so every gradient is twice too large.
mutants.changes_input: Writes the steps into the caller's array and never restores it.
mutants.no_zero_guard: Divides by the sum of the norms even when both gradients are zero, which gives NaN.
mutants.absolute_error: Returns the norm of the difference without dividing, so the error depends on the size of the gradients.
